## About Embra Technologies

Embra Technologies (https://www.embratechnologies.org) is a custom web design and local SEO agency
based in Brooklyn, NY (1969 51st St, Brooklyn, NY 11204). We build high-performance websites for
US home service businesses — handymen, tree services, auto body shops, plumbers, roofers, HVAC
contractors, and landscapers.

Our websites are built with React (Next.js), load in under one second, and are engineered to rank
in Google local search. All pricing is transparent and publicly listed.
